SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

Foreign Affairs Section,
Special Branch.    File No.................... Date....June 30, 1942.

（印：Shanghai Municipal Police Sp. Br. Registry. No. U. 79 Date. 7-7-42）

SUBJECT: Visit to French Police regarding census
of Russian Emigrants

Sir,

I beg to report that at 10.00 a.m. on 30-6-42
the vice chairman of the Russian Emigrants Committee
D.V. Kochneff and the undersigned visited the French
Police. C.I. Emelianoff is on leave and we interviewed
Chief Inspector Delorme. I stated the reason of our
visit, explained the plan of registration of Russian
Emigrants through the Committee and asked him if a similar
procedure could be adopted in the French Concession.
Mr. Delorme informed me that the French Police intend to
use their previous registration in order to ascertain
the changes in the number of residents of the Concession
and explained that it would be most difficult to exclude
the Russians from the other residents. He told me that
if the S.M.P. authorities are interested in the total
number of Russian Emigrants the French Police will give
all information regarding this question.

In my opinion Mr. Delorme has his instructions
and is not the man to reach any decisions when some
changes in routine work are concerned.

（印：FILE）

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
N.D. Polonsky.

A. Yamaguchi
Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
Special Branch.

（印：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 7/7/42.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

外事科，
特别支部。    档案号.................... 日期....1942年6月30日。

（印：上海公共租界警务处特别支部登记室。编号 U. 79 日期 1942年7月7日）

事由：就俄侨人口普查事宜拜访法国警察当局

先生：

谨此报告，1942年6月30日上午10时，俄侨委员会副主席 D.V. Kochneff 与本人一同拜访了法国警察当局。C.I. Emelianoff 正在休假，因此我们会见了警长 Delorme。本人陈述了来访缘由，解释了通过该委员会进行俄侨登记的计划，并询问他法租界是否可采用类似的程序。Delorme 先生告知我，法国警察当局打算利用其先前的登记资料，以查明租界居民人数的变动情况，并解释说，将俄国人从其他居民中单独区分出来是极为困难的。他告诉我，如果工部局警务处当局对俄侨总数感兴趣，法国警察当局将提供有关此问题的所有信息。

依本人之见，Delorme 先生已有既定指令，在涉及日常工作程序的变更时，他并非能够做出决定之人。

（印：归档）

先生，
您忠顺的仆人，
N.D. Polonsky。

A. Yamaguchi
特别支部外事科主管警官。

（印：由（特别支部）登记室编入索引，日期 1942年7月7日。）
